name: SkyRisk Lab Academico - Python 3.13
postCreateCommand: if [ ! -e .venv ]; then python -m venv --without-pip .venv; fi && test -x .venv/bin/python && python -m pip --python .venv/bin/python install --only-binary=:all: -r requirements.txt && python -m pip --python .venv/bin/python check

postAttachCommand.server: .venv/bin/python -B -m streamlit run app_academica.py --server.headless true --server.enableCORS true --server.enableXsrfProtection true
